assertions.name: factorized_binding_within_1p25x_T_3He
assertions.source: max over {T,³He} of max(miss,1/miss) for B=E₀·(A−1)·L̄_comp; derived inputs (E₀, bond-type sub-braid traces), no fitted coeff.

description: Leading-order JSJ-additive heavy-isotope mass channel (channel 2 of q-clt-jsj-mass-scaling). m_qCLT_approx(Z,N) = Z·m_p + N·m_n − B(Z,N). The additive structure is exact (volume additive under torus gluing); the absolute residual is the nucleon-mass gap, reported in BOTH regimes — production (+2.89%, proved-only linking weight) and spectral-corrected (~-819 ppm; EXPLORATORY, derived θ/(8ℏ²), not wired per production-vs-exploratory discipline). The channel ALSO carries a self-contained DERIVED binding — the factorized q-CLT B = E₀·(A−1)·(Σ n_type·L_type)/C(A,2), E₀=m_e/(q₀(q₀−1)) derived, L_type the 2-nucleon sub-braid log-traces (recorded canonical) — which resolves the T/³He isospin split (L_nn>L_pp) with NO fit. Caveats: chain-vs-allpairs bond count is a modeling choice (not derived); A≥4 undershoots; absolute mass still carries the nucleon gap. NOT an 'exact asymptotic limit': the leading-term error is the binding fraction (plateaus, does not vanish for heavy A).

factorized_qclt.form: B = E₀·(A−1)·(Σ_type n_type·L_type)/C(A,2); E₀ = m_e/(q₀(q₀−1)) derived (q₀,m_e only, no fit); L_type = 2-nucleon sub-braid log-trace per bond type.
factorized_qclt.modeling_choice: chain (A−1) bond count is a modeling choice, NOT derived (blocker 3); all-pairs C(A,2) overbinds; A≥4 undershoots ~1.6×.
factorized_qclt.absolute_caveat: channel mass still carries the +2.89% nucleon gap (blocker 1); the binding is derived/gate-respecting, the absolute mass is not ppb.
